title: What inputs do stego image sign, image verify and image retrieve take to check an image signature, and does STEGO make a keyless signature itself?
description: Sign the image (ST-BLD-CMD05) is built as appbuild.SignImage, for a CI provider that signs for itself: GitHub signs both SBOM attestations about the image digest with actions/attest, and STEGO checks each bundle with the provider's verifier (gh attestation verify) and AcceptableSignature (ST-BLD-SP02), then writes signature.json. The check needs inputs that the CLI commands do not name: stego image sign (ST-BLD-CLI05) names only --image, but the check needs the trusted digest of image.json, the SPDX and the CycloneDX bundle, the trusted signer (issuer and workflow subject at its exact reference, or a key digest) and the verifier (the GitHub CLI path and the source repository). Get the verification of an image (ST-BLD-QRY03) and Get a verified image (ST-BLD-QRY04) must also check the signature, and stego image verify (ST-BLD-CLI09) and stego image retrieve (ST-BLD-CLI10) name no signature input either. The trusted signer is the one the service's delivery pipeline names (ST-DLV-INV04), which Delivering does not build yet. Options: (a) add flags --record-sha256, --spdx-bundle, --cyclonedx-bundle, --signer-issuer, --signer-subject (or --signer-key-sha256), --gh and --source-repository to the three commands, until Delivering gives the trusted signer; (b) read the trusted signer from a signed delivery pipeline record that Delivering writes, and the bundles from the image folder by fixed names; (c) make STEGO sign keyless itself, which needs sigstore-go in the main module (today only internal/assure has it). Recommendation: (a) now, with (b) when Delivering builds ST-DLV-INV04; not (c), because the provider already signs and a second dependency tree in the main module is not needed. Until this is decided, the CLI handler ST-BLD-CH04 (cmd/stego/image_sign.go) is not written, and QRY03 and QRY04 check no signature.
